sections.title: Runtime trace of a shipped system

questions.title: One request end to end
questions.ask: Pick one LLM system you shipped. Trace a single user request from entry to answer: every hop, store, and model call.
questions.purpose: Separates hands-on runtime knowledge from reference-architecture fluency.

questions.title: Timeout mid-answer
questions.ask: In that trace, a retrieval call times out after the model has started answering. What did the system actually do?
questions.purpose: Tests real failure handling, not target design.

questions.title: Per-tenant filtering
questions.ask: Where exactly is a document filtered out for a user who must not see it: index, query, or answer? Why there?

questions.title: Halyard ledger
questions.ask: On the Halyard ledger reconciliation, how did you agree the mismatch threshold with the client's finance team?

questions.title: Brightwater cutover
questions.ask: During the Brightwater cutover, who could stop the release, and did anyone use that right?
